A Hong Kong man has admitted to repeatedly raping his daughter over six years, using threats and promises to ensure her cooperation.

news.headline: At least 11 people killed in South Africa township shooting
news.summary: Armed men open fire at a house party in a Durban township, killing a pregnant woman and 10 others.
